mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate investments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points (UNRATE rise > 0.3pp) signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST > 1150k) and retail sales (RSAFS > 480k) indicates robust consumer demand that elevates corporate revenue expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1150k and RSAFS > 480k.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 100 (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing contraction that triggers supply chain disruptions and profit margin compression, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained consumer price inflation above 245 (CPIAUCSL > 245) indicates persistent inflation that forces central bank rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 245.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payrolls increase exceeding 200k (PAYEMS growth > 200k) reflects strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS above their 12-month moving averages signal active monetary tightening, which compresses equity multiples and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS exceed 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production decline (INDPRO < 100) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.3%) indicates supply-labor market contraction that depresses corporate profits, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 4.3%.
